<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Ask whether a stage of the pipeline may run, and record that it passed (`pipeline:`).

```text
The stages anchors.yaml declares, asked by the pipeline:

  pipeline:
    stages:
      review-release:
        branches: [review]
        requires: [flow, { gates: ci }]
        verify: node scripts/smoke-review.mjs
      production-release:
        branches: [production]
        requires:
          - flow
          - any: [{ passed: review-release }, { from: "hotfix/*" }]
        verify: node scripts/smoke-prod.mjs

  anchors pipeline can-run <stage>   the first job: refuses a stage that may not run
  anchors pipeline record <stage>    the last job: runs verify:, records the pass on the sha
                                     (alias done; record reads clean to shellcheck, done does not)
  anchors pipeline run <stage>       can-run, run:, verify: and the record, in one step

A stage the configuration does not declare does not run. The branch and the sha come from
--branch and --sha, or $GITHUB_REF_NAME and $GITHUB_SHA. The pass is a commit status
anchors/pipeline/<stage>, written and read with the gh CLI (GH_TOKEN, statuses: write).
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors pipeline
```

## Subcomandos

### `anchors pipeline can-run`

Refuse a stage that may not run on this branch and sha.

#### Uso

```bash
anchors pipeline can-run <stage> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--branch` |  | the branch the stage runs on (default $GITHUB_REF_NAME) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--sha` |  | the commit the stage runs on (default $GITHUB_SHA) |

### `anchors pipeline record`

Run the stage's verify: and record on the sha that the stage passed.

#### Uso

```bash
anchors pipeline record <stage> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--branch` |  | the branch the stage runs on (default $GITHUB_REF_NAME) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--sha` |  | the commit the stage runs on (default $GITHUB_SHA) |

### `anchors pipeline run`

Run a stage: can-run, its run:, its verify:, and the record.

#### Uso

```bash
anchors pipeline run <stage> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--branch` |  | the branch the stage runs on (default $GITHUB_REF_NAME) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--sha` |  | the commit the stage runs on (default $GITHUB_SHA) |

## Changelog, pull requests e pipeline — família

Comandos da mesma família — o que distingue cada um:

| Comando | O que faz |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors changelog`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/changelog/) | Build the technical changelog from the commits, release by release |
| [`anchors commit-msg`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/commit-msg/) | Confront the commit message with the format the changelog will read |
| [`anchors pr-body`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/pr-body/) | Write the lines linking this work's cards, in the platform's syntax |
| [`anchors backfill-labels`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/backfill-labels/) | Write into open issues the links the new version began to mark |
| [`anchors report`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/report/) | Generate reports in docs/ by perspective (cuts of what Anchors measures) |
| [`anchors branch`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/branch/) | Confront merges and commits with the project's branch flow (`branch_flow:`) |
| **`anchors pipeline`** | Ask whether a stage of the pipeline may run, and record that it passed (`pipeline:`) |
